# Sparked Connection

> Sparked Connection is a London-based, professional matchmaking agency for busy, relationship-minded people across the UK. It offers personality-led introductions, curated singles events and a discreet, human approach: no swiping and no algorithm-only matching. The agency is ABIA registered and approved. It was founded by Anna, who is the lead matchmaker and personally oversees introductions.

## Key facts

- Service: one-to-one matchmaking for professionals over 25 seeking a meaningful, long-term relationship
- Approach: personality and compatibility-based matching, supported by technology and reviewed by a human matchmaker
- Every paid membership begins with a private, no-pressure consultation
- Free option: the Singles Club (Bronze). Free to join; you are introduced if you match with a client or attend an event
- Paid memberships: Gold (£2,000, 12 months, includes 1:1 consultations, bespoke search, dating coaching and VIP event access) and Platinum (£3,800, two Gold memberships for two friends joining together). Check the plans page for current details
- Events: curated singles events (social nights, creative workshops, travel and adventure). Matching is included with every event ticket
- Contact: hello@sparkedconnection.com
